parameters.query:
-- Morning backup check: the newest try, and the newest good backup. Always one row.
select
  (select max(finished_at) from backup_runs where ok) as last_good,
  newest.ok as newest_ok,
  newest.error as newest_error,
  newest.started_at as newest_at,
  now() as checked_at
from (select 1) as one
left join lateral (
  select ok, error, started_at from backup_runs order by started_at desc, id desc limit 1
) as newest on true;

parameters.content: Every morning at 9: posts to #support-alerts if the newest backup try failed, or if there has been no good backup for 26 hours. All well: posts nothing.
